# Single-cell analysis - Myeloid classification

Here, we will perform the spatial single cell analysis steps for the myeloid panel. 

## Load data

```{r load data, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#sce with all cells
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds") 
sce

#TME sce
sce_TME <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds") 
sce_TME

#Myeloid sce
sce_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")
sce_MY
```

## 1. Data integration

```{r}
# New information from TME sce 
colnames(colData(sce_TME))[!colnames(colData(sce_TME)) %in% colnames(colData(sce))]
## To transfer: astir_immune_combined, GMM_immune_combined, cluster_selected, immune_metacluster

# New information from myeloid sce 
colnames(colData(sce_MY))[!colnames(colData(sce_MY)) %in% colnames(colData(sce_TME))]
## To transfer: my_cluster_selected, astir_myeloid_type, myeloid_metacluster, my_cluster_names
```

## Combine myeloid and TME cluster/metacluster/color information

```{r combine tumor TME, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
## 1. Cell type information 
### 1. TME
TME_info <- colData(sce_TME) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(immune_cluster_selected = paste0("immune_",sce_TME$cluster_selected)) %>% select(cell_id, astir_immune_combined, GMM_immune_combined, immune_cluster_selected, immune_metacluster)

### 2. MY
MY_info <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% 
  mutate(myeloid_metacluster = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$myeloid_metacluster), 
         my_cluster_selected = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$my_cluster_selected),
         my_cluster_names = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$my_cluster_names),
         myeloid_district = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$myeloid_district),
         myeloid_district_names = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$myeloid_district_names)) %>% 
  select(cell_id, my_cluster_selected, astir_myeloid_type, myeloid_metacluster, my_cluster_names, myeloid_district, myeloid_district_names)

### Add to sce
sce$astir_immune_combined <- TME_info$astir_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$GMM_immune_combined <- TME_info$GMM_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_cluster_selected <- TME_info$immune_cluster_selected[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_metacluster <- TME_info$immune_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]

sce$my_cluster_selected <- MY_info$my_cluster_selected[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$astir_myeloid_type <- MY_info$astir_myeloid_type[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$myeloid_metacluster <- MY_info$myeloid_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$my_cluster_names <- MY_info$my_cluster_names[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$myeloid_district <- MY_info$myeloid_district[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$myeloid_district_names <- MY_info$myeloid_district_names[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]

## 2. Color mapping
metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$immune_metacluster
metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster <- metadata(sce_MY)$colors$myeloid_metacluster

names(metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster) <- paste0("MY_", names(metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster))

## 3. Cluster channels 
rowData(sce)$immune_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_TME)$sub_cluster
rowData(sce)$MY_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_MY)$myeloid_cluster_1
```


```{r}
## Create combined cell type category 
sce$celltype_combined <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$myeloid_metacluster), sce$myeloid_metacluster,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$analysis_cat))

sce$celltype_combined_fine <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$my_cluster_names), sce$my_cluster_names,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$analysis_cat))

unique(sce$celltype_combined)
unique(sce$celltype_combined_fine)
```


```{r save_objects, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Save sce
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")
```


## Heatmap visualization 

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")

sce$celltype_combined_broad <- ifelse(str_detect(sce$celltype_combined, "MY"), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$celltype_combined)

sce$astir_combined_broad <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$astir_immune_combined), sce$astir_immune_combined,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$astir_combined), sce$astir_combined, NA))
```

```{r}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and G

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$celltype_combined_broad,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$broad_cluster)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over celltype_combined_broads 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, celltype_combined_broad)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-celltype_combined_broad) %>% aggregate(by = list(celltype_combined_broad = spatial$celltype_combined_broad), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir prediction 

# Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,astir_combined_broad) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = astir_combined_broad,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

## GMM cell types per cluster
GMM_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,GMM_immune_combined) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = GMM_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# ha_astir_GMM <- HeatmapAnnotation(
#   astir_combined_broad = anno_barplot(astir_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col)),
#   GMM_immune_combined = anno_barplot(GMM_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col)),
#                             border = TRUE,
#                             annotation_name_rot = 90,
#                             gap = unit(3,"mm"),
#                             which = "row")

### 2.3 Metadata features

#Number of cells per celltype_combined_broad 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(celltype_combined_broad, ncells)

# # Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,PID) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# Proportion of ISUP_combined grade per cluster
ISUP_combined <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,ISUP_combined) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = ISUP_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# Proportion of pT stage per cluster
pT <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,pT_combined) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT <- pT %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT <- pT %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = pT_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# Proportion of necrose per cluster
necrose <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,necrose) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
necrose <- necrose %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
necrose <- necrose %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = necrose,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

PDL1_score <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,PDL1_score) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = PDL1_score,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")


ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_barplot(ISUP_combined, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined)),
                              pT_combined = anno_barplot(pT, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined)),
                            necrose = anno_barplot(necrose, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$necrose)),
                            PDL1_score = anno_barplot(PDL1_score, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")


### 3. Annotation dataframe

anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(celltype_combined_broad, ncells)

### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs")),
        col = col_main,
        name = "exprs",
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, 
        #row_split = anno$immune_cat,
        cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
        row_title = NULL,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2"
        )+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs"))))#+
  #ha_astir_GMM+
  #ha_spatial+
  #ha_meta

# Create legends for annotation 
#lgd <- Legend(title = "Immune metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$celltype_combined_broad), 
              #legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$celltype_combined_broad))

# Draw heatmap
draw(h)
#draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))
```

# 2. Spatial analysis 

## 2A. Differential interaction testing 

### Celltype 

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")

### General phenotype interaction difference

library(spicyR)
library(lisaClust)

## ISUP 

set.seed(22)

# Generate segmentedCells object 
cur_sce <- sce

cells <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(cur_sce))
cells$x <- cur_sce$Pos_X
cells$y <- cur_sce$Pos_Y
cells$imageID <- cur_sce$sample_id
cells$imageCellID <- cur_sce$ObjectNumber
cells$cellType <- cur_sce$celltype_combined

cells_sc <- SegmentedCells(cells, cellProfiler = TRUE)

# Add condition and patient id
unique(cur_sce$ISUP_combined)

cat <- relevel(x=factor(cur_sce$ISUP_combined), ref = "1/2")

imagePheno(cells_sc) <- DataFrame(imageID = cur_sce$sample_id, 
          PID = cur_sce$PID,
          ISUP = cat
          )

cells_sc

# Run differential interaction analysis 
spicyTest <- spicy(cells_sc, 
      condition = "ISUP", 
      subject = "PID", 
      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam())

saveRDS(spicyTest, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_ISUP.rds")

topPairs(spicyTest, cutoff = 0.05, n=40)

out_ISUP <- signifPlot(spicyTest,
                       fdr = TRUE,
                       marksToPlot = unique(sce$celltype_combined))

out_ISUP
```

#### Heatmap visualization 

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")
spicyTest <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_ISUP.rds")
spicyTest_1 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_pT.rds")
spicyTest_2 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_necrose.rds")
spicyTest_3 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_PDL1.rds")
```


```{r}
### 1. ISUP 
results <- spicyTest
marksToPlot <- unique(sce$celltype_combined)
breaks <- NULL
comparisonGroup <- NULL
colours = c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
cutoff = 0.05
fdr = TRUE

if (is.null(comparisonGroup)) {
    coef <- 2
  } else {
    coef <- which(levels(results$condition) == comparisonGroup)
  }
  marks <- unique(results$comparisons$from)
  
  if (is.null(breaks)) breaks <- c(-3, 3, 0.5)
  breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
  pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
  col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)

  pVal <- results$p.value[, coef]

  if (min(pVal, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    pVal[pVal == 0] <-
      pVal[pVal == 0] + 10^floor(log10(min(pVal[pVal > 0], na.rm = TRUE)))
  }

  if (fdr) {
    pVal <- stats::p.adjust(pVal, method = "fdr")
  }

  isGreater <- results$coefficient[, coef] > 0

  results$coefficient[, 1]
  results$coefficient[, coef]
  
  pVal <- log10(pVal)

  pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])

  pVal <- matrix(pVal, nrow = length(marks))
  colnames(pVal) <- marks
  rownames(pVal) <- marks
  
  pVal[abs(pVal) < -log10(0.1)] <- 0
  
  anno <- data.frame(celltypes = marksToPlot, cat = "ISUP_combined")
  
  anno$type <- ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "MY"),"MY","Not_MY")
  
  pVal_ISUP <- pVal
  
h_ISUP <- Heatmap(pVal_ISUP,
          col = col,
          name = "log10(p)",
          row_split = anno$type,
          column_split = anno$type,
          cluster_columns = FALSE, 
          cluster_rows = FALSE, 
          border = TRUE, 
          row_title = "From", 
          column_title = "To", column_names_side = "top")%v% 
  columnAnnotation(ISUP = anno_simple(anno$cat, gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined[2]), 
                                     border = TRUE))

h_ISUP

### 2. pT stage

results <- spicyTest_1
marksToPlot <- unique(sce$celltype_combined)
breaks <- NULL
comparisonGroup <- NULL
colours = c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
cutoff = 0.05
fdr = TRUE

if (is.null(comparisonGroup)) {
    coef <- 2
  } else {
    coef <- which(levels(results$condition) == comparisonGroup)
  }
  marks <- unique(results$comparisons$from)
  
  if (is.null(breaks)) breaks <- c(-3, 3, 0.5)
  breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
  pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
  col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)

  pVal <- results$p.value[, coef]

  if (min(pVal, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    pVal[pVal == 0] <-
      pVal[pVal == 0] + 10^floor(log10(min(pVal[pVal > 0], na.rm = TRUE)))
  }

  if (fdr) {
    pVal <- stats::p.adjust(pVal, method = "fdr")
  }

  isGreater <- results$coefficient[, coef] > 0

  results$coefficient[, 1]
  results$coefficient[, coef]
  
  pVal <- log10(pVal)

  pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])

  pVal <- matrix(pVal, nrow = length(marks))
  colnames(pVal) <- marks
  rownames(pVal) <- marks
  
  pVal[abs(pVal) < -log10(0.1)] <- 0
  
  anno <- data.frame(celltypes = marksToPlot, cat = "pT_combined")
  
  anno$type <- ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "MY"),"MY","Not_MY")
  
  pVal_T <- pVal
  
h_pT <- Heatmap(pVal_T, 
          col = col,
          name = "log10(p)",
          row_split = anno$type,
          column_split = anno$type,
          cluster_columns = FALSE, 
          cluster_rows = FALSE, 
          border = TRUE, 
          row_title = "From", 
          column_title = "To", column_names_side = "top")%v% 
  columnAnnotation(pT = anno_simple(anno$cat, gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined[2]), 
                                     border = TRUE))
h_pT

### 3. Necrose

results <- spicyTest_2
marksToPlot <- unique(sce$celltype_combined)
breaks <- NULL
comparisonGroup <- NULL
colours = c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
cutoff = 0.05
fdr = TRUE

if (is.null(comparisonGroup)) {
    coef <- 2
  } else {
    coef <- which(levels(results$condition) == comparisonGroup)
  }
  marks <- unique(results$comparisons$from)
  
  if (is.null(breaks)) breaks <- c(-3, 3, 0.5)
  breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
  pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
  
  col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)

  pVal <- results$p.value[, coef]

  if (min(pVal, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    pVal[pVal == 0] <-
      pVal[pVal == 0] + 10^floor(log10(min(pVal[pVal > 0], na.rm = TRUE)))
  }

  if (fdr) {
    pVal <- stats::p.adjust(pVal, method = "fdr")
  }

  isGreater <- results$coefficient[, coef] > 0

  results$coefficient[, 1]
  results$coefficient[, coef]
  
  pVal <- log10(pVal)

  pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])

  pVal <- matrix(pVal, nrow = length(marks))
  colnames(pVal) <- marks
  rownames(pVal) <- marks
  
  pVal[abs(pVal) < -log10(0.1)] <- 0
  
  anno <- data.frame(celltypes = marksToPlot, cat = "necrose")
  
  anno$type <- ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "MY"),"MY","Not_MY")
  
  pVal_necrose <- pVal
  
h_necrose <- Heatmap(pVal_necrose, 
          col = col,
          name = "log10(p)",
          row_split = anno$type,
          column_split = anno$type,
          cluster_columns = FALSE, 
          cluster_rows = FALSE, 
          border = TRUE, 
          row_title = "From", 
          column_title = "To")%v%
    columnAnnotation(necrose = anno_simple(anno$cat, gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$necrose[2]), 
                                     border = TRUE))
h_necrose
```

#### Most changing interactors

```{r}
pVal <- rbind(pVal_ISUP, pVal_necrose, pVal_T, pVal_PDL1)

# Increased 
df_MY_int <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:14, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef > 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

df_NotMY_int <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:14, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef > 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(!str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(df_MY_int, aes(x = reorder(celltype,-n), y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", fill = "#DD524BFF")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("celltype")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,55))+
ggplot(df_NotMY_int, aes(x = reorder(celltype,-n), y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", fill = "#DD524BFF")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("celltype")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,55))

# Decreased
df_MY_dec <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:14, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef < 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

df_NotMY_dec <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:14, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef < 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(!str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))
```

#### Heterotypic interactions 

##### Tumor 

```{r}
### Neighborhood expansion graph
sce <- aggregateNeighbors(sce, colPairName = "neighborhood", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "celltype_combined", proportions = FALSE, name = "count_neighbors")
```

```{r}
## Step 1: Retrieve neighbors table
cur_dat <- sce$count_neighbors %>% as.data.frame
rownames(cur_dat) <- sce$cell_id
cur_dat$PID <- sce$PID
cur_dat$celltype_combined <- sce$celltype_combined

cur_dat$ISUP_combined <- sce$ISUP_combined
cur_dat$pT_combined <- sce$pT_combined
cur_dat$necrose <- sce$necrose
cur_dat$PDL1_score <- sce$PDL1_score

cur_dat$ISUP_combined[cur_dat$ISUP_combined == "3/4"] <- "1"
cur_dat$ISUP_combined[cur_dat$ISUP_combined == "1/2"] <- "0"
cur_dat$pT_combined[cur_dat$pT_combined == "3/4"] <- "1"
cur_dat$pT_combined[cur_dat$pT_combined == "1/2"] <- "0"

# Count heterotypic interactions of immune cells / stromal TO tumor cells
out_1 <- cur_dat %>% filter(celltype_combined != "tumor") %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% pivot_longer(2:14, names_to = "celltype_int", values_to = "int_n") %>% filter(celltype_int == "tumor") %>% group_by(cell_id) %>% mutate(n_sum = sum(int_n)) %>% ungroup() 

# Mean number of heterotypic interactions per PID 
out_2 <- out_1 %>% pivot_longer(4:7, names_to = "cat", values_to = "cat_value") %>% select(cell_id, PID, cat, cat_value, n_sum) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(n_av = mean(n_sum)) %>% select(PID, cat,cat_value, n_av) %>% unique() %>% filter(!is.na(cat_value))

p_values_df <- compare_means(formula = n_av ~ cat_value, data = out_2, group.by = "cat", p.adjust.method = "BH")

ggplot(out_2, aes(x = cat_value, y = n_av, fill = cat))+
  facet_wrap(~cat)+
  geom_boxplot()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greys")+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Mean number of heterotypic tumor interactions per PID")+
  geom_text(data = p_values_df, aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = paste0("p = ", p.adj)),
            vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 4)
  
```

#### Survival testing 

##### Mean 

```{r}
# Extract spicy output from L function (mean difference across specific radi)
## This is the same for all different comparisons 
spicy_out <- spicyTest$dataframe

#spicy_out <- as.data.frame(do.call("cbind",spicyTest$pairwiseAssoc))
rownames(spicy_out) <- spicy_out$imageID

## Different options for selecting interactions
# A: Only select interactions FROM myeloid cells
#selected_pairs <- str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY") & str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "MY")
# B: Only select interactions FROM myeloid cells TO non-myeloid cells

selected_pairs <- (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY") |
 (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "MY"))) &
 (!str_detect(colnames(spicy_out), "Unknown_Other"))

spicy_out_selected <- spicy_out[,selected_pairs]

spicy_out_selected <- spicy_out_selected %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
spicy_out_selected$PID <- sce$PID[match(spicy_out_selected$sample_id, sce$sample_id)]

spicy_out_selected_long <- spicy_out_selected %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(spicy_out_selected)-1), names_to = "pair", values_to = "coef")

# Perform mean interaction score split for all categories 
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce$PID))

for(i in unique(spicy_out_selected_long$pair)){
spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_selected_long %>% filter(pair == i) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_coef = mean(coef,na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(PID, mean_coef) %>% unique()

spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_loop %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean_coef < mean(spicy_out_loop$mean_coef, na.rm = TRUE), "low", "high"))

out_df[,i] <- spicy_out_loop$cat[match(out_df$PID, spicy_out_loop$PID)]
}

# Filter columns with only one entry of high/low
include <- c("PID",out_df %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(out_df), names_to = "int", values_to = "value") %>% group_by(int) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% filter(sum > 2) %>% pull("int") %>% unique())
out_df <- out_df[, colnames(out_df) %in% include]

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))


# Add info on hetero or homotypic interaction
cur_surv_plot$int_type <- ifelse(str_count(cur_surv_plot$group, "MY") > 1, "homotypic", "heterotypic")

library(ggnewscale)
ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,-log10(p)), y = type, col = result, size = -log10(p), shape = int_type))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(18, 16))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  facet_grid(~ direction, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")

# Add as result for mean
cur_surv_mean_results <- cur_surv_plot 
```

```{r}
)
```

##### Cox Model 

###### Categorical

```{r}
## Add covariates 
out_df

for(i in c(2:41)){
  out_df[,i] <- as.factor(out_df[,i])
  out_df[,i] <- relevel(out_df[,i], ref = "low")
}

#Based on proportions
covariates <- out_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,-PID) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = out_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

```{r}

### General phenotype interaction difference

library(spicyR)

## ISUP 

# Generate segmentedCells object

cells <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(cur_sce))
cells$x <- cur_sce$Pos_X
cells$y <- cur_sce$Pos_Y
cells$imageID <- cur_sce$sample_id
cells$imageCellID <- cur_sce$ObjectNumber
cells$cellType <- cur_sce$celltype_combined_fine

cells_sc <- SegmentedCells(cells, cellProfiler = TRUE)

# Add condition and patient id
unique(cur_sce$ISUP_combined)

cat <- relevel(x=factor(cur_sce$ISUP_combined), ref = "1/2")

imagePheno(cells_sc) <- DataFrame(imageID = cur_sce$sample_id, 
          PID = cur_sce$PID,
          ISUP = cat
          )

cells_sc

# Run differential interaction analysis 
spicyTest_fine <- spicy(cells_sc, 
      condition = "ISUP", 
      #from = c("MY_CD163", "MY_CD163_HLADR","MY_CD163_CD206"),
      subject = "PID",

      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 20))

saveRDS(spicyTest_fine, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_fine_ISUP.rds")

cells <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(cur_sce))
cells$x <- cur_sce$Pos_X
cells$y <- cur_sce$Pos_Y
cells$imageID <- cur_sce$sample_id
cells$imageCellID <- cur_sce$ObjectNumber
cells$cellType <- cur_sce$celltype_combined_fine

cells_sc <- SegmentedCells(cells, cellProfiler = TRUE)

# Add condition and patient id
unique(cur_sce$pT_combined)

cat <- relevel(x=factor(cur_sce$pT_combined), ref = "1/2")

imagePheno(cells_sc) <- DataFrame(imageID = cur_sce$sample_id, 
          PID = cur_sce$PID,
          pT = cat
          )

cells_sc

# Run differential interaction analysis 
spicyTest_fine_1 <- spicy(cells_sc, 
      condition = "pT", 
      subject = "PID", 
      includeZeroCells = TRUE,
      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam())

saveRDS(spicyTest_fine_1, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_fine_pT.rds")
```

#### Heatmap visualization 

```{r}
spicyTest_fine <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_fine_ISUP.rds")
spicyTest_fine_1 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_fine_pT.rds")
spicyTest_fine_2 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_fine_necrose.rds")
spicyTest_fine_3 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_fine_PDL1_score.rds")
```

```{r}
results <- spicyTest_fine
marksToPlot <- unique(sce$celltype_combined_fine)
breaks <- NULL
comparisonGroup <- NULL
colours = c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
cutoff = 0.05
fdr = TRUE

if (is.null(comparisonGroup)) {
    coef <- 2
  } else {
    coef <- which(levels(results$condition) == comparisonGroup)
  }
  marks <- unique(results$comparisons$from)
  
  if (is.null(breaks)) breaks <- c(-3, 3, 0.5)
  breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
  pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
  col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)

  pVal <- results$p.value[, coef]

  if (min(pVal, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    pVal[pVal == 0] <-
      pVal[pVal == 0] + 10^floor(log10(min(pVal[pVal > 0], na.rm = TRUE)))
  }

  if (fdr) {
    pVal <- stats::p.adjust(pVal, method = "fdr")
  }

  isGreater <- results$coefficient[, coef] > 0

  results$coefficient[, 1]
  results$coefficient[, coef]
  
  pVal <- log10(pVal)

  pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])

  pVal <- matrix(pVal, nrow = length(marks))
  colnames(pVal) <- marks
  rownames(pVal) <- marks
  
  pVal[abs(pVal) < -log10(0.05)] <- 0
  
  anno <- data.frame(celltypes = marksToPlot)
  
  anno$type <- ifelse(str_detect(anno$celltypes, "MY"),"MY","Not_MY")
  
  pVal_fine_ISUP <- pVal
  
  Heatmap(pVal_fine_ISUP,
          col = col,
          name = "log10(p)",
          row_split = anno$type,
          column_split = anno$type,
          cluster_columns = FALSE, 
          cluster_rows = FALSE, 
          border = TRUE, 
          row_title = "From", 
          column_title = "To")
```

#### Oncoprint-like visualization

```{r}
pVal_ISUP_up <- pVal_fine_ISUP
pVal_T_up <- pVal_fine_T
pVal_necrose_up <- pVal_fine_necrose
pVal_PDL1_up <- pVal_fine_PDL1

pVal_ISUP_up[pVal_ISUP_up < 0 ] <- 0
pVal_T_up[pVal_T_up < 0] <- 0
pVal_necrose_up[pVal_necrose_up < 0] <- 0
pVal_PDL1_up[pVal_PDL1_up < 0] <- 0

# List of differential test results
mat <- list(ISUP_34 = pVal_ISUP_up,pT_34 = pVal_T_up, necrose_1 = pVal_necrose_up, PDL1_1 = pVal_PDL1_up)

viz_col_up <- setNames(c("#E41A1C","#377EB8", "#984EA3","#4DAF4A"), 
                      c("ISUP_34", "pT_34", "necrose_1", "PDL1_1"))

# Alter-fun 
viz_fun_up <- list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, 
            gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black")),
  ISUP_34 = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x - 0.25*w, y + 0.25*h, w*0.5, h*0.5, 
            gp = gpar(fill = viz_col_up["ISUP_34"], col = "black")),
  pT_34 = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x + 0.25*w, y + 0.25*h, w*0.5, h*0.5, 
            gp = gpar(fill = viz_col_up["pT_34"], col = "black")),
  necrose_1 = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x - 0.25*w, y - 0.25*h, w*0.5, h*0.5, 
            gp = gpar(fill = viz_col_up["necrose_1"], col = "black")),
  PDL1_1 = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x + 0.25*w, y - 0.25*h, w*0.5, h*0.5, 
            gp = gpar(fill = viz_col_up["PDL1_1"], col = "black"))
        )


onco_up <- oncoPrint(mat, alter_fun = viz_fun_up, col = viz_col_up, show_column_names = TRUE, row_split = anno$type, column_split = anno$type, row_title = "From",
          column_title = "To", alter_fun_is_vectorized = FALSE)
draw(onco_up)
```

#### Most changing interactors

```{r}
pVal_fine <- rbind(pVal_fine_ISUP, pVal_fine_necrose, pVal_fine_T, pVal_fine_PDL1)

# Increased 
df_MY_int <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:27, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef > 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

df_NotMY_int <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:27, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef > 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(!str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(df_MY_int, aes(x = reorder(celltype,-n), y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", fill = "#DD524BFF")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("celltype")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,150))+
ggplot(df_NotMY_int, aes(x = reorder(celltype,-n), y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", fill = "#DD524BFF")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("celltype")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,150))

# Decreased
df_MY_dec <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:27, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef < 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

df_NotMY_dec <- pVal %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("from") %>% pivot_longer(2:27, values_to = "coef", names_to = "to") %>% filter(coef != 0 & coef < 0) %>% pivot_longer(1:2, names_to = "direction", values_to = "celltype") %>% mutate(celltype = str_split(celltype,"\\.", simplify = TRUE)[,1]) %>% filter(!str_detect(celltype, "MY")) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(df_MY_dec, aes(x = reorder(celltype,-n), y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", fill = "#83A3CDFF")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("celltype")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,150))+
ggplot(df_NotMY_dec, aes(x = reorder(celltype,-n), y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", fill = "#83A3CDFF")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("celltype")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,150))
```

#### Survival testing 

```{r}
# Extract spicy output from L function (mean difference across specific radi)
## This is the same for all different comparisons 
spicy_out <- spicyTest_fine$dataframe

### Selection options:
# A: Only select interactions FROM myeloid cells
#selected_pairs <- c(TRUE, str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY")[2:677], TRUE, TRUE)

# B: Only select interactions FROM myeloid cells TO non-myeloid cells
selected_pairs <- c(TRUE, str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY")[2:677] & (!str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "MY")[2:677]), TRUE, TRUE)


spicy_out_selected <- spicy_out[,selected_pairs]

spicy_out_selected_long <- spicy_out_selected %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:145, names_to = "pair", values_to = "coef")

# Perform mean interaction score split for all categories 
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce$PID))

for(i in unique(spicy_out_selected_long$pair)){
spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_selected_long %>% filter(pair == i) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_coef = mean(coef,na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(PID, mean_coef) %>% unique()

spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_loop %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean_coef < mean(spicy_out_loop$mean_coef, na.rm = TRUE), "low", "high"))

out_df[,i] <- spicy_out_loop$cat[match(out_df$PID, spicy_out_loop$PID)]
}

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
```

```{r}
# Color for heatmaps 
colours <- c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
breaks <- c(-3, 3, 0.5)
breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Remove columns with one level (high/low)
remove <- apply(out_df[2:145], MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){length(unique(x))})
remove <- names(remove)[remove == 1]
out_df <- out_df[,!colnames(out_df) %in% remove]

remove_2 <- apply(out_df[2:145], MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(x){sum(x == "high", na.rm = TRUE) < 3})
remove_2 <- names(remove_2)[remove_2 == 1]
out_df <- out_df[,!colnames(out_df) %in% remove_2]

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.1, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out)) %>% filter(p_adj < 0.1)

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, name = "log10(FDR)")
```

##### Lasso Cox Model 

###### Categorical 

```{r}
## 1. Based on categorical interaction scores
out_df <- na.omit(out_df)
out_df <- out_df %>% filter(OS_months != 0)

for(i in c(2:145)){
  out_df[,i] <- as.factor(out_df[,i])
  out_df[,i] <- relevel(out_df[,i], ref = "low")
}

x <- data.matrix(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)) #predictor variables

y <- Surv(time = out_df$OS_months, event = out_df$status_OS) #response variables

## Run lasso 
require(doMC)
library(glmnet)
library(broom) 

registerDoMC(cores = 20)
set.seed(220196)
cv.fit <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family="cox", type.measure = "C", nfolds = 100, parallel = TRUE)
plot(cv.fit)

fit <- glmnet(x, y, family="cox")

coef(fit, s = cv.fit$lambda.min)

# ## Run lasso 10 times (with 10 fold validation each run) and average error curves to be more robust
# MSEs <- NULL
# for (i in 1:10){
#                   cv <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family="cox", type.measure = "C", nfolds = 100, parallel = TRUE)
#                   MSEs <- cbind(MSEs, cv$cvm)
#                   }
# 
# rownames(MSEs) <- cv$lambda
# lambda.min <- as.numeric(names(which.min(rowMeans(MSEs))))
# 
# fit <- glmnet(x, y, family="cox")
# coef(fit, s = lambda.min)

#Extract output
lasso_df <- broom::tidy(fit) %>% filter(lambda == cv.fit$lambda.min)

ggplot(lasso_df, aes(x = reorder(term,-exp(estimate)), y = exp(estimate))) +
  geom_point(size = 4, aes(color = exp(estimate)>1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans="log")+
  ylab("Lasso HR")+
  xlab("Predictors")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  ggtitle("OS")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#377EB8","#E41A1C"))
```

```{r}
  r = abs(test_viz[i, j])/max_value * min(unit.c(width, height))*0.5
  grid.circle(x = x, y = y, r = r,
              gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = ifelse(test_viz[i, j] > 0, "darkred","darkblue")))
}


Heatmap(PID_cor_diff, cell_fun = cell_fun, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = TRUE, column_split = anno$type, row_split = anno$type)
```

#### Test for interacting differences

e.g. Fisher/Chi-Square test 

```{r}
## Currently based on ISUP grading (TO DO across categories)
test_viz_1
test_viz_0

cur_PID_high <- length(colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, ISUP_combined, necrose, PDL1_score, pT_combined) %>% filter(ISUP_combined == "3/4") %>% pull(PID) %>% unique())

cur_PID_low <- length(colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, ISUP_combined, necrose, PDL1_score, pT_combined) %>% filter(ISUP_combined == "1/2") %>% pull(PID) %>% unique())

## 1. Attraction changes
test_viz_out <- rbind(
test_viz_1 %>% rownames_to_column("partner") %>% pivot_longer(2:14, names_to = "interaction", values_to = "PID_interacting") %>% mutate(interaction_category = ifelse(PID_interacting >= 0, "attraction", "avoidance")) %>% mutate(PID_interacting_abs = abs(PID_interacting)) %>% mutate(category = "high", PID_total = cur_PID_high) %>% mutate(PID_not_interacting = PID_total - PID_interacting),
test_viz_0 %>% rownames_to_column("partner") %>% pivot_longer(2:14, names_to = "interaction", values_to = "PID_interacting") %>% mutate(interaction_category = ifelse(PID_interacting >= 0, "attraction", "avoidance")) %>% mutate(PID_interacting_abs = abs(PID_interacting)) %>% mutate(category = "low", PID_total = cur_PID_low) %>% mutate(PID_not_interacting = PID_total - PID_interacting)
)

chisq.test(out_mat_test)
```

## 2C. B cell patch analysis 

```{r}
## Patch detection
sce <- patchDetection(sce,
               patch_cells = sce$celltype_combined == "B_cell",
               colPairName = "neighborhood",
               min_patch_size = 5,
               name = "patch_B_cell",
               expand_by = 0, 
               img_id = "sample_id", 
               BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 20))

## 1. Number of patches per PID 
n_Bpatch_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, patch_B_cell) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(patch_B_cell)) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  group_by(PID) %>% 
  count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

sce$B_patch_present <- sce$PID %in% n_Bpatch_PID$PID


## 3. Create B cell score per PID 
# No B cells = 1 
# No B cell patches = 2
# Small B cell patches = 3
# Large B cell patches = 4 

B_cells_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, celltype_combined) %>% filter(celltype_combined == "B_cell") %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined) %>% count()

B_cells_PID$B_patch <- B_cells_PID$PID %in% n_Bpatch_PID$PID


B_cells_PID$B_score <- ifelse(B_cells_PID$n < 3 & B_cells_PID$B_patch == FALSE, "No_B_cell", "B_cell_patch" ) 


cur_PID <- B_cells_PID %>% filter(B_score == "B_cell_patch") %>% pull(PID)

sce$B_cell_score <- sce$PID %in% cur_PID

sce$B_cell_score_fine <- ifelse(sce$B_patch_present, "B_patch", ifelse(sce$B_cell_score, "B_cell", "No_B_cell"))
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID) %>% unique() %>% as.data.frame

rownames(PID_metagroups) <- NULL
rownames(PID_metagroups) <- PID_metagroups$PID

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

Cox_df$M2_CD8_dist_category <- factor(sce$M2_CD8_dist_category[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)], levels = c("high","low"))

Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])

#Based on patient groups
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -PID) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res_1 <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop_1 <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res_1$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res_1$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res_1$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res_1$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res_1$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res_1$waldtest["pvalue"],3))


#Plot hazard ratiOS
#hr_prop <- 
ggplot(plot_df_prop_1, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("CD8_M2_groups")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
#scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```
### Differential abundance testing 

#### All celltypes 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

abundances <- table(sce$celltype_combined, sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]
meta$M2_CD8_dist_category <- relevel(x=factor(meta$M2_CD8_dist_category), ref = "low")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$M2_CD8_dist_category),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$M2_CD8_dist_category)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~M2_CD8_dist_category, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$M2_CD8_dist_category))%v%
  columnAnnotation(M2_CD8_dist_category = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$M2_CD8_dist_category)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

```{r}
## Analyse tumor compartment expression 

# Subset to tumor cells
sce_tumor <- sce[,sce$analysis_cat == "tumor"]

# Tumor relevant markers 
rowData(sce)$tumor_type_markers <- rownames(sce) %in% c("HLADR","IDO1","CD274","Ki67","Vimentin","CXCL13")

# Aggregate expression per PID 
spatialpheno_mean_PID <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_tumor, ids = sce_tumor$PID,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_tumor)$tumor_type_markers)


# Test for differential expression per category 
test <- t(assay(spatialpheno_mean_PID, "exprs")[rowData(spatialpheno_mean_PID)$tumor_type_markers,]) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(M2_CD8_dist_category = spatialpheno_mean_PID$M2_CD8_dist_category) 

test <- test[!is.na(test$M2_CD8_dist_category),]

ggplot(test, aes(x=M2_CD8_dist_category, y=CD274)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = M2_CD8_dist_category), size = 3, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Reds")+
    theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  ylab("CD274 - Mean expression per PID")+
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test")



test_result <- compare_means(c(HLADR,IDO1,CD274,Ki67,Vimentin,CXCL13)~M2_CD8_dist_category, method = "kruskal.test",data = test)

test_result$p.adj <- p.adjust(test_result$p, method = "BH") 

test_result$psignif.adj <- as.matrix(symnum(test_result$p.adj,
       cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
       symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")))[,1]

rownames(test_result) <- test_result$.y.

sig.poteins <- unfactor(test_result$.y.[test_result$p.adj < 0.05])





# Aggregate expression per spatial phenotype
spatialpheno_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_tumor, ids = sce_tumor$spatial_CD8_pheno,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_tumor)$tumor_cluster_channel)

mat_scaled<- t(scale(t(assay(spatialpheno_mean_sce, "exprs"))))


highest_cat <- mat_scaled %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:4, names_to = "spatial_CD8", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(gene) %>% mutate(max = max(exprs)) %>% filter(exprs == max) %>% select(gene, spatial_CD8) %>% as.data.frame() %>% column_to_rownames("gene")

## Visualize 

# Heatmap 
h <- Heatmap(assay(spatialpheno_mean_sce, "exprs"), col = viridis(100), name = "exprs", cluster_columns = FALSE, row_names_side = "left", show_row_dend = FALSE)+
  #Heatmap(mat_scaled, name = "scaled exprs", cluster_columns = FALSE)+
  rowAnnotation(cat = anno_simple(highest_cat, col = metadata(sce)$colors$spatial_CD8_pheno, width = unit(10, "mm")))+
  rowAnnotation(test = anno_text(test_result$psignif.adj))

lgd_cat <- Legend(title = "Highest_exprs", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$spatial_CD8_pheno), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$spatial_CD8_pheno))


draw(h,annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_cat))

# Violin plot
plotExpression(spatialpheno_mean_PID, 
               features = sig.poteins,
               x = "spatial_CD8_pheno", exprs_values = "exprs", 
               colour_by = "spatial_CD8_pheno") +
    theme(axis.text.x =  element_text(angle = 90))+
    scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$spatial_CD8_pheno)
```

### Myeloid phenotype 
based on Ruben Casanova and Hammerl et al., 2022

```{r}
## Step 1: Retrieve neighbors table
cur_dat <- sce$count_neighbors %>% as.data.frame
rownames(cur_dat) <- sce$cell_id
cur_dat$PID <- sce$PID
cur_dat$celltype_combined <- sce$celltype_combined
cur_dat$M2_CD274_status <- sce$M2_CD274_status
cur_dat$M2_CD8_dist_category <- sce$M2_CD8_dist_category

## Step 2: Define M2-like macrophages into CD8 interactors or not interactors
cur_dat <- cur_dat %>% filter(celltype_combined == "MY_M2_like") %>% 
  mutate(M2_type = ifelse(CD8_T_cell >= 1, "interactor", "not_interactor")) 

## Step 3: Compare for CD274 status of M2-like 
cur_plot <- cur_dat %>% group_by(M2_type) %>% count(M2_CD274_status) %>% mutate(fra = n/(sum(n)))

ggplot(cur_plot, aes(x = M2_type, y = fra, fill = M2_CD274_status))+
  geom_tile(position = "stack", color = "black")+#+alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Fraction of CD274+ M2-like per group")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")

## Step 4: Compare between M2-CD8 dist categories 
cur_plot_1 <- cur_dat %>% group_by(M2_type) %>% filter(!is.na(M2_CD8_dist_category)) %>% count(M2_CD8_dist_category) %>% mutate(fra = n/(sum(n)))

ggplot(cur_plot_1, aes(x = M2_type, y = fra, fill = M2_CD8_dist_category))+
  geom_tile(position = "stack", color = "black")+#+alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Fraction of CD274+ M2-like per group")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Reds")

cur_plot_2 <- cur_dat %>% group_by(M2_CD8_dist_category) %>% filter(!is.na(M2_CD8_dist_category)) %>% count(M2_type) %>% mutate(fra = n/(sum(n)))

ggplot(cur_plot_2, aes(x = M2_CD8_dist_category, y = fra, fill = M2_type))+
  geom_tile(position = "stack", color = "black")+#+alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Fraction of CD8-M2 interactors per group")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1")

## Step 5: Look at ratio between interactors / not-interactors
cur_test <- cur_dat %>% group_by(PID, M2_type) %>% count() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% filter(sum > 10)
  
cur_test <- cur_test %>% pivot_wider(names_from = M2_type, values_from = n) %>% mutate(ratio = interactor/not_interactor) %>% filter(interactor > 1 & not_interactor > 1)

cur_test$M2_CD8_dist_category <- cur_dat$M2_CD8_dist_category[match(cur_test$PID, cur_dat$PID)]

cur_test <- cur_test[!is.na(cur_test$ratio),]
cur_test <- cur_test[!is.na(cur_test$M2_CD8_dist_category),]

ggplot(cur_test, aes(x = M2_CD8_dist_category, y = ratio))+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = M2_CD8_dist_category), size = 3, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "grey")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Reds")+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test")

cur_test$ratio_category <- ifelse(cur_test$ratio < quantile(cur_test$ratio, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3))[2], "low", 
       ifelse(cur_test$ratio > quantile(cur_test$ratio, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3))[2] & cur_test$ratio < quantile(cur_test$ratio, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3))[3], "medium", "high"))

cur_test$ratio_category <- factor(cur_test$ratio_category, levels = c("high","medium","low"))

sce$ratio_category <- cur_test$ratio_category[match(sce$PID,cur_test$PID)]
```

## Normalized interaction scores 
see Wang et al., 2023 (Nature)

```{r}
# Step 1: Retrieve neighbors table
cur_dat <- sce$count_neighbors %>% as.data.frame
rownames(cur_dat) <- sce$cell_id
cur_dat$PID <- sce$PID
cur_dat$celltype_combined_fine <- sce$celltype_combined_fine

# Step 2: Define index and test cell and count interactions per PID
test_cell <- "MY_CD163"
index_cell <- "CD8_T_cell"

cur_int <- cur_dat %>% filter(celltype_combined_fine == test_cell) %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% pivot_longer(2:27, names_to = "interacting_celltype", values_to = "n_int") %>% filter(interacting_celltype == index_cell) %>% group_by(PID) %>% summarise(n_int = sum(n_int))
  
# Step 3: Add the total count of cells per PID
## Total number of test cells
count_int <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_fine) %>% count() %>% filter(celltype_combined_fine == test_cell)
cur_int$n_total_int <- count_int$n[match(cur_int$PID, count_int$PID)]

## Total number of index cells 
count_index <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_fine) %>% count() %>% filter(celltype_combined_fine == index_cell)
cur_int$n_total_index <- count_index$n[match(cur_int$PID, count_index$PID)]

## Total number of cells   
count_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
cur_int$n_total_PID <- count_PID$n[match(cur_int$PID, count_PID$PID)]

# Step 4: Create different cell-cell interaction scores 
cur_final <- cur_int %>% mutate(score_int_int = n_int/n_total_int) %>% mutate(score_int_index = n_int/n_total_index) %>% mutate(score_int_total = n_int/n_total_PID)

## Optional: Split a score by the mean 
cur_final$int_mean_split <- ifelse(cur_final$score_int_total > mean(cur_final$score_int_total, na.rm = TRUE), "high", "low")

sce$int_mean_split <- cur_final$int_mean_split[match(sce$PID, cur_final$PID)]
```


```{r}
### Perform interaction scoring for a number of cell types ###

# See above for step-explanations 
cur_dat <- sce$count_neighbors %>% as.data.frame
rownames(cur_dat) <- sce$cell_id
cur_dat$PID <- sce$PID
cur_dat$celltype_combined_fine <- sce$celltype_combined_fine

out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(cur_dat$PID))

celltypes <- unique(cur_dat$celltype_combined_fine)
#celltypes <- celltypes[celltypes %in% c("MY_CD163","MY_CD163_CD206","MY_CD163_HLADR")]

for(test_cell in celltypes){
index_cell <- "MY_CD163"

cur_int <- cur_dat %>% filter(celltype_combined_fine == test_cell) %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% pivot_longer(2:27, names_to = "interacting_celltype", values_to = "n_int") %>% filter(interacting_celltype == index_cell) %>% group_by(PID) %>% summarise(n_int = sum(n_int))
  
count_int <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_fine) %>% count() %>% filter(celltype_combined_fine == test_cell)
cur_int$n_total_int <- count_int$n[match(cur_int$PID, count_int$PID)]
    
count_index <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_fine) %>% count() %>% filter(celltype_combined_fine == index_cell)
cur_int$n_total_index <- count_index$n[match(cur_int$PID, count_index$PID)]

count_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
cur_int$n_total_PID <- count_PID$n[match(cur_int$PID, count_PID$PID)]

cur_final <- cur_int %>% mutate(score_int_int = n_int/n_total_int) %>% mutate(score_int_index = n_int/n_total_index) %>% mutate(score_int_total = n_int/n_total_PID)

cur_final$int_mean_split <- ifelse(cur_final$score_int_index > mean(cur_final$score_int_index, na.rm = TRUE), "high", "low")

out_df[,paste0(test_cell,"_to_", index_cell,"_score")] <- cur_final$score_int_index[match(out_df$PID, cur_final$PID)]
}
```

```{r}
library(survival)

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
out_df

rownames(out_df) <- out_df$PID
#rownames(PID_metagroups) <- PID_metagroups$PID

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- out_df

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])

#Based on patient groups
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -PID) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res_1 <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop_1 <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res_1$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res_1$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res_1$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res_1$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res_1$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res_1$waldtest["pvalue"],3))


#Plot hazard ratiOS
#hr_prop <- 
ggplot(plot_df_prop_1, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("CD8_M2_groups")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

### Differential abundance testing 

#### Non-myeloid cells 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

sce_selected <- sce[,(!str_detect(sce$celltype_combined, "MY")) & sce$my_AgM_group %in% c("AgM_low","AgM_high")]
sce_selected <- sce_selected[,sce_selected$celltype_combined != "tumor"]

abundances <- table(sce_selected$celltype_combined, sce_selected$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_selected)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_selected$PID),]
meta$my_AgM_group <- relevel(x=factor(meta$my_AgM_group), ref = "AgM_low")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$my_AgM_group),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$my_AgM_group)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~my_AgM_group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$my_AgM_group))%v%
  columnAnnotation(my_AgM_group = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$my_AgM_group)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

```{r}
sce_selected <- sce[,sce$celltype_combined == "tumor"]
```

# 3.1 Cellular neighborhoods

## Detect CN

In the next section, we will define cellular neighborhoods by clustering cells based on their neighboring cells.

### Based on Metacluster

```{r neighborhood-1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(imcRtools)
library(bluster)

# Build spatial knn graph
sce <- buildSpatialGraph(sce, img_id = "sample_id", type = "knn", k = 20, 
                         coords = c("Pos_X",  "Pos_Y"),
                         #max_dist = 30,
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())

colPairNames(sce) #now includes knn_interaction_graph

# Aggregate across neighbors
sce <- aggregateNeighbors(sce, colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph", 
                          aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "metacluster_combined", 
                          proportions = TRUE)

head(sce$aggregatedNeighbors)

# Perform cluster sweep for kmeans (silhouette width, wcss)
set.seed(22)
clust_list <- lapply(2:20, function(k){
  cur_km <- kmeans(sce$count_neighbors, centers = k)
  return(list(wss = sum(cur_km$withinss),
           clusters = cur_km$cluster))
})

sil <- vapply(lapply(clust_list, `[[`, 2), 
              function(x) mean(approxSilhouette(sce$count_neighbors, x)$width), 
              0)

ggplot(data.frame(k = 2:20, sil = sil))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil, col = sil))+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil,col=sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("k")+
  ylab("Mean silhouette width")+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")

ggplot(data.frame(k = 2:20,wss = unlist(lapply(clust_list, `[[`, 1))))+
  geom_point(aes(k, wss, col = wss))+
  geom_line(aes(k, wss, col = wss))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("k")+
  ylab("Total WCSS")+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")

# Select 13 clusters
set.seed(22)
cur_clusters <- kmeans(sce$count_neighbors, centers = 15, nstart = 100)$cluster

sce$cellular_neighborhood <- as.factor(cur_clusters)
```


### Based on Exprs

```{r neighborhood-1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(imcRtools)
library(bluster)

# Build spatial knn graph
sce <- buildSpatialGraph(sce, img_id = "sample_id", type = "knn", k = 20, 
                         coords = c("Pos_X",  "Pos_Y"),
                         #max_dist = 30,
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())

colPairNames(sce) #now includes knn_interaction_graph

# Aggregate across neighbors based on expression 
rowData(sce)$cluster_channel_combined <- ifelse(rowData(sce)$TME_cluster_channel == TRUE|rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster_channel == TRUE, TRUE, FALSE)

sce <- aggregateNeighbors(sce, colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph",
                          aggregate_by = "expression", assay_type = "exprs",
                          subset_row = rowData(sce)$cluster_channel_combined
                          )


head(sce$mean_aggregatedExpression)

# Perform cluster sweep for kmeans (silhouette width, wcss)
set.seed(22)
clust_list <- lapply(2:20, function(k){
  cur_km <- kmeans(sce$mean_aggregatedExpression, centers = k)
  return(list(wss = sum(cur_km$withinss),
           clusters = cur_km$cluster))
})

sil <- vapply(lapply(clust_list, `[[`, 2), 
              function(x) mean(approxSilhouette(sce$mean_aggregatedExpression, x)$width), 
              0)

ggplot(data.frame(k = 2:20, sil = sil))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil, col = sil))+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil,col=sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("k")+
  ylab("Mean silhouette width")+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")

ggplot(data.frame(k = 2:20,wss = unlist(lapply(clust_list, `[[`, 1))))+
  geom_point(aes(k, wss, col = wss))+
  geom_line(aes(k, wss, col = wss))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("k")+
  ylab("Total WCSS")+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")

# Select 13 clusters
set.seed(22)
cur_clusters <- kmeans(sce$mean_aggregatedExpression, centers = 13, nstart = 10)$cluster

sce$cellular_neighborhood_exprs <- as.factor(cur_clusters)
```

Rich heatmap visualization 

```{r rich heatmap}
### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Visualize cell type proportions of cellular neighborhoods
cn_prop_wide <- colData(sce) %>% as_tibble() %>%
    group_by(cellular_neighborhood, metacluster_combined) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

#Number of cells per cluster 
n_cells <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cellular_neighborhood) %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% count() 

# Proportion of grade per cluster
grade <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cellular_neighborhood,grade) %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
grade <- grade %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
grade <- grade %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cellular_neighborhood,names_from = grade,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cellular_neighborhood")

# Proportion of pT stage per cluster
pT <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cellular_neighborhood,pT_simple) %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT <- pT %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT <- pT %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cellular_neighborhood,names_from = pT_simple,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cellular_neighborhood")

# Proportion of pN stage per cluster
pN <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cellular_neighborhood,pN_simple) %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pN <- pN %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pN <- pN %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cellular_neighborhood,names_from = pN_simple,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cellular_neighborhood")

# Number of contributing patients
cluster_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cellular_neighborhood,PID) %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>0) %>% group_by(cellular_neighborhood) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("cellular_neighborhood")

# Define colors for cellular neighborhood 
cn_col <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(length(unique(sce$cellular_neighborhood))), sort(unique(sce$cellular_neighborhood)))         

metadata(sce)$colors$cellular_neighborhood <- cn_col

# Metadata annotation
ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(cellular_neighborhood = anno_simple(unfactor(n_cells$cellular_neighborhood),pch = unfactor(n_cells$cellular_neighborhood), border=TRUE,col=metadata(sce)$colors$cellular_neighborhood),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$n, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF")),
                            n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF")),
                            grade = anno_barplot(grade, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$grade)),
                            pT = anno_barplot(pT, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_simple)),
                            pN = anno_barplot(pN, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pN_simple)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 3. Plot heatmap ###
h <- Heatmap(cn_prop_wide,
        name = "MC proportion",

        row_title = NULL,
```

## Survival analysis 

### For OS on CN proportions

```{r cox}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_cellular_neighborhood <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cellular_neighborhood,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_cellular_neighborhood <- PID_cellular_neighborhood %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_cellular_neighborhood %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "cellular_neighborhood",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
colnames(PID_metagroups) <- paste0("CN",colnames(PID_metagroups))

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$grade <- factor(sce$grade[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)], levels = c("3","2","1"))
Cox_df$pT_simple <- as.factor(sce$pT_simple[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$pN_simple <- as.factor(sce$pN_simple[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$pM_simple <- as.factor(sce$pM_simple[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -age, -grade, -pT_simple, -pN_simple, -pM_simple, -CN7) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ age + grade + pT_simple + pN_simple + pM_simple +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ CN7"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("CN")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```
